explanation: Backtrack from every board cell. A visited matrix prevents using a cell twice in one path; restore the mark when returning so other paths can use it.
timeComplexity: O(R times C times 4^L) upper bound for R rows, C columns, and word length L.
spaceComplexity: O(R times C + L) auxiliary space.
attribution: Original repository-authored Blind75 JavaScript algorithm, promoted from the validated correct fixtures. Collection membership follows Crackr; no external solution service is used.
